description: Intent i003 (snapshot s02, branch hwmon-sysfs-scaled-divisor) complete with one high-confidence finding. FINDING: drivers/gpu/drm/amd/pm/powerplay/hwmgr/smu7_thermal.c lines 262-281, function smu7_fan_ctrl_set_fan_speed_rpm: "tach_period = 60 * crystal_clock_freq * 10000 / (8 * speed);" (line 280). Untrusted source: u32 value from the hwmon store handler amdgpu_hwmon_set_fan1_target (drivers/gpu/drm/amd/pm/amdgpu_pm.c:2836-2841, kstrtou32; SENSOR_DEVICE_ATTR(fan1_target, S_IRUGO|S_IWUSR) at line 3291) flowing through amdgpu_dpm_set_fan_speed_rpm(adev, value). Violated invariant: validation at lines 269-275 checks only the raw input (speed == 0, speed < fanInfo.ulMinRPM, speed > fanInfo.ulMaxRPM) with no bound on the derived expression 8*speed; 8*speed wraps to 0 in 32-bit unsigned for speed > UINT_MAX/8. Unsafe use: the wrapped product is the denominator of the tach_period division while programming CG_TACH_CTRL TARGET_PERIOD, giving integer division by zero / kernel oops. Exact contrast evidence in the same snapshot: vega10_thermal.c:307 and vega20_thermal.c:190 both contain the seed fix "(!speed || speed > UINT_MAX/8)" while smu7_thermal.c does not. Candidates classified: reported=smu7_thermal.c:280; safe=vega10_thermal.c:307, vega20_thermal.c:190, g762.c:184 (clamp ULONG_MAX/f2), max6650.c:279 (clamp 240..30000), adt7475.c:273, adt7470.c:661 (val<=0 rejected), emc2305.c:392 (max_state nonzero at probe), max31760.c:426, aspeed-pwm-tacho.c:573 (fan_ctrl range-checked, constant divisor PWM_MAX); unresolved=aspeed-g6-pwm-tach.c:312 (hardware tach read path, out of branch scope) and it87.c:1478 (FAN_TO_REG zero-guard not line-verified). Limitations: exploitability gated by firmware-provided ulMinRPM/ulMaxRPM (reachable when ATOM PowerPlay reports large u32 ulMaxRPM, same gating as pre-patch vega10 that upstream still fixed); pp_funcs dispatch wiring and amdgpu_hwmon visibility gates not re-verified line-by-line; non-fan hwmon attributes only pattern-scanned. Final artifact written to agent-state/findings/i003.json with snapshots_checked=["s02"], execution_status=complete.
